gates.title: Verify booked flights and Chennai connections
gates.detail: Actual tickets must establish arrival/departure, baggage and airline reporting. The saved 12:45 arrival and 13:05 return are assumptions.

gates.title: Add the fifth adult and extra bed at Exotica Squares
gates.detail: Agoda voucher checked: 15–17 Dec, two King Rooms with Garden View, four adults and zero extra beds. Obtain approval for the fifth adult and final extra charge; ₹3,000 for two nights is provisional.

gates.title: Pibo Homestay booked for all five · 17–18 Dec
gates.detail: Email/PDF checked: Family Room for three + Super Deluxe Room for two, room only, ₹4,004.70 incl GST. Hotel confirms rooms ready on arrival. Check-in 10:00; checkout 09:00.

gates.title: Confirm Baratang cab · both sights and all waiting
gates.detail: Pibo quotes ₹4,000 cab-only for 11 Dec airport-to-hotel pickup plus 12 Dec Baratang; traveller says arranged. Confirm vehicle, both caves + Mud Volcano, waiting, gate/convoy reporting, island crossing, boats/jeeps, permits and local charges. Driver only; no separate full-day guide.

gates.title: Complete all five snorkelling forms
gates.detail: Each person reviews their own medical answers and waiver. Obtain provider confirmation after completion; do not pay a second advance. Private links stay in the group.

gates.title: Confirm activity meeting instructions and returns
gates.detail: Seahawks scuba and kayak pickups/launch/finish; Turquoise reporting buffer and return location. Confirm the next-day kayak fits the dive operator’s recovery instructions.

gates.title: Arrange each airport, hotel and jetty transfer
gates.detail: Five adults plus driver and bags. Avoid paying twice for included Seahawks pickups. Include Neil snorkelling rides, early checkout, luggage storage and any chosen sunrise outing.

gates.title: Book the Jail show when 11 Dec opens
gates.detail: Check the official portal from 4 Dec; 17:50 Hindi preferred, 18:50 Friday English fallback. Separate museum entry, last entry, show report and rides. Release date/hour is not guaranteed.

gates.title: Reconcile Neil price, hotel payments and storage
gates.detail: Exotica PDF has no price; obtain actual Agoda charge/payment, fifth-adult approval, breakfast and checkout terms. Pibo received ₹2,000: confirm hotel/cab allocation and direct cancellation policy. Arrange luggage storage after Pibo’s 09:00 checkout.

11.headline: Museum 15:00–16:00 · prefer the 17:50 show
11.status: Planning targets · flight and tickets to verify
11.tonight: Early dinner and bed; Baratang wake-up may be around 02:30. Driver must confirm pickup.
11.protect: If arrival is delayed, move the museum to 17 Dec afternoon instead of stacking another outing.

12.headline: ~03:00 cab pickup · confirm with the driver
12.status: Cab arranged per traveller · ₹4,000 package cab-only; scope/pickup pending
take: Original photo ID for all five
Water, snacks + cash for agreed local charges
12.tonight: Recover from the full day. Pack for the Havelock ferry; agree tomorrow’s jetty pickup.
12.protect: Both caves and Mud Volcano need the written cab scope, all waiting and a practical return convoy. No fixed pickup alert until confirmed.

13.headline: Report at Haddo 11:30 · ferry sails 12:30
13.tonight: Get scuba car/pickup details by 19:00. Arrange an early/packed or late breakfast and sleep early.
13.protect: Radhanagar is the only optional afternoon outing. Skip it if the hotel stop or rest runs late.

14.headline: 05:30 scuba slot · pickup time still to confirm
14.status: Booked · 50 min underwater · morning finish provisional
14.tonight: Pack ferry bags before the early kayak. Confirm the 03:30 programme pickup/return and breakfast plan.
14.protect: Reserve the morning to about 10:00 provisionally. Ask Seahawks about recovery and the following morning’s kayaking; office pin is not the confirmed meeting point.

15.headline: 03:30 kayak · report for Makruzz at 12:30
15.status: Kayak/ferry booked · Exotica reserves four; fifth adult pending
15.tonight: Share tomorrow’s reporting pin, confirm the snorkelling reporting buffer and arrange your own ride.
15.protect: Kayak finish ~05:00 is provisional. Protect recovery, checkout/storage and the two-hour ferry report. Go to sunset only if ready to leave by ~16:00; otherwise use 16 Dec.

16.headline: 10:00 snorkelling · confirm the reporting buffer
take: Agreed payment method for ₹8,673 group balance
16.tonight: Pack before bed. Confirm early breakfast, checkout and the 08:30 Neil jetty report; sunrise stays optional.
16.protect: Bridge only after a local daylight low-tide/access check and if back for breakfast by ~08:15. Keep 09:15–12:30 clear for the snorkelling programme; actual operator instructions take priority.

17.headline: Report at Neil jetty 08:30 · ferry sails 09:30
17.status: Ferry and Pibo for all five confirmed · rooms ready on arrival
17.tonight: Pack for 09:00 Pibo checkout. Arrange luggage storage until pickup; verify flight/Chennai connection, airport ride and baggage rules.
17.protect: Skip Sitapur if it threatens breakfast, checkout or the ferry report. After arrival, choose one outing; Cellular Jail is a fallback only if missed on 11 Dec.

18.headline: Pibo checkout 09:00 · airport ride waits for flight verification
18.tonight: Trip home; check rooms and vehicle for belongings before leaving.
18.protect: Pack and settle before 09:00 checkout; arrange luggage storage until airport pickup. The 10:15–10:30 ride / 10:45–11:00 airport target applies only if the 13:05 flight is confirmed. No sightseeing today.

items.label: Original government photo ID for every adult
Save private flight/ferry/hotel/activity confirmations on each phone
Save reporting pins and a local map before weak-signal journeys
Agree cash/UPI/card coverage for balances and local charges; advances are already included
Swimwear or rash guard, towel and a dry change
Dry bag / splash protection for phone and essentials
Water bottle, hat and sun protection permitted by the operator
Complete your own required forms and follow operator screening/instructions
Grippy walking footwear for caves and rocky Bridge access
Light clothes, spare socks and a light rain layer
Personal medicines as prescribed, toiletries and glasses
Small torch for the cave outing and pre-dawn starts
Phone, cables, plug chargers and power bank
Check the booked airline’s battery and baggage rules
Open your day links and check Google Maps before leaving the hotel

reminders.activation: Only after all bookings and critical details are final AND the user enters the preparation phase. No messages or notifications now.
reminders.audience: Team andaman group plus each member individually; verify the then-current group roster privately before sending.
reminders.noisePolicy: Only useful alerts. Bundle preparation tasks, avoid duplicate reminders, no alerts for optional sightseeing; notify again only for a material time/location change or unresolved essential action.

preparation.what: One combined documents, forms, balances, packing and transfer checklist; include the single itinerary link.
One final essentials check; omit tasks already completed.

trip.when: One next-day briefing in the evening
trip.what: Tomorrow’s first essential time, pickup/report pin, what to carry and what needs confirmation. Avoid separate alerts for each optional stop.

trip.when: Before an essential departure or reporting deadline
trip.what: One practical leave-now alert based on the confirmed pickup/route plus buffer. Suppress it when an arranged driver pickup already covers the same action.

reminders.channels: A static website cannot send scheduled WhatsApp notifications. Calendar/reminder alerts and any WhatsApp delivery must be configured and tested in the preparation phase; delivery is not active or guaranteed by this plan.
